display_text: Suppressed Power ** Adds [[Unholy Burst#Unholy Burst|Unholy Burst]][[Unholy Burst#Unholy Burst|Unholy Burst]]: An unholy weapon is imbued with unholy power. This power makes the weapon evil-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against all of good alignment and an extra 3 to 18 on a critical for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 4 to 24 for a x3 multiplier, and 5 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.[[Category:Unholy Burst items]] ** Adds [[Spell Focus| Necromancy Focus II]][[Spell Focus| Necromancy Focus II]]: +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.[[Category: Necromancy Focus +2 items]] ** Becomes [[Bind|Bound to Character on Acquire]][[Category:Binds to character]][[Category:Binds on acquire]][[Category:Suppressed Power items]]
